step1_analysis.circuit_type: Active Core of an LC Bandpass Filter
step1_analysis.description: This circuit forms the active portion of a tunable LC bandpass filter. It includes a differential input transconductance stage (XM1, XM2) to inject the RF signal, cross-coupled MOS varactors (XM5, XM6) for frequency tuning, and current mirrors (XM3/XM4, XM7/XM8) for biasing.

paper_reference.title: A 1.3-V 5-mW Fully Integrated Tunable Bandpass Filter at 2.1 GHz in 0.35-m CMOS

center_frequency.description: The frequency at which the bandpass filter achieves its maximum voltage gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined primarily by the LC tank resonance: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=3.7nH and C=1.55pF added in the testbench, f is approximately 2.1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The external LC tank in the testbench is explicitly tuned to match the paper's target center frequency.

peak_gain.description: Maximum differential voltage gain at the center frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * R_tank. With gm ~ 1mS (from 0.3mA tail current) and R_tank = 10kOhm, Gain ~ 10 V/V = 20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The gain depends heavily on the parallel resistance of the LC tank used in the testbench and the absence of the full Q-enhancement loop in the extracted netlist.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the active filter core.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. At 1.8V and ~0.6mA total bias current (tail + asymmetric load), P ~ 1.1 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for the SKY130 1.8V supply and the specific 0.9V biasing applied to the current mirrors in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the center frequency, peak gain, and power consumption of the active bandpass filter core with an ideal LC tank.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Q-Enhanced LC Bandpass Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM7 VOUT_PLUS N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM5 VOUT_MINUS VOUT_PLUS VOUT_PLUS VOUT_PLUS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM2 VOUT_PLUS VIN_MINUS N6 N6 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 VOUT_MINUS VIN_PLUS N2 N2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 N3 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM8 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM6 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS VOUT_PLUS VOUT_PLUS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Fix floating nodes (connect diff pair sources to tail current drain)
Vshort1 N2 N3 0
Vshort2 N6 N3 0

* Biasing and Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVIN_PLUS VIN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5
VVIN_MINUS VIN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5
VN0 N0 0 0.9
VN4 N4 0 0.9

* LC Tank (Tuned to ~2.1 GHz)
L1 VDD VOUT_PLUS 3.7n
L2 VDD VOUT_MINUS 3.7n
C1 VOUT_PLUS 0 1.55p
C2 VOUT_MINUS 0 1.55p
R1 VOUT_PLUS VDD 10k
R2 VOUT_MINUS VDD 10k

* Differential Output
E_diff VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS 1

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 100MEG 10G
meas ac peak_gain MAX vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
meas ac peak_freq MAX_AT vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
quit
.endc
